history.phase: اصلاح محدودیت تعداد خطوط در ورود DXF
history.summary: کنترل سقف ۵۰ هزار خط را پس از اعتبارسنجی آبجکت‌های جایگزین‌شده قرار دادم تا خطوطی که به آبجکت تبدیل می‌شوند، اشتباهاً در تعداد دیوارهای واردشده محاسبه نشوند.
حذف خودکار دیوارهایی را که نقطهٔ شروع یا پایان فلش با آن‌ها هم‌پوشانی دارد متوقف کردم؛ اکنون دیوارها در کنترل برخورد باقی می‌مانند و در نبود مسیر ایمن، فلش مسدود گزارش می‌شود.

history.phase: اصلاح حفظ نام اصلی لایه‌های DXF
history.summary: در خروجی DXF تشخیص لایهٔ واردشده را از پیشوند نام جدا کردم تا نام لایه‌های اصلی مانند RD_PLAN بدون پسوند اضافی حفظ شود؛ نام‌گذاری لایه‌های داخلی تغییر نکرد.

history.phase: جلوگیری از ورود هندسه بیضی سه‌بعدی به نقشه دوبعدی
history.summary: در پردازش ELLIPSE فایل DXF، بیضی‌های دارای بردار نرمال خارج از صفحه XY، به‌جای تصویرسازی نادرست در نقشه دوبعدی با هشدار NON-XY OCS کنار گذاشته می‌شوند.

history.phase: جلوگیری از تبدیل خاموش خطوط سه‌بعدی DXF به هندسه دوبعدی
history.summary: خطوط LINE با ارتفاع Z غیرصفر یا نامعتبر، به‌جای فرافکنی بی‌هشدار روی صفحه XY با هشدار NON-XY LINE کنار گذاشته می‌شوند؛ خطوط XY بدون تغییر وارد می‌شوند.

history.phase: جلوگیری از ورود بی‌هشدار پلی‌لاین‌های دارای ارتفاع به نقشه دوبعدی
history.summary: ارتفاع گروه 38 در LWPOLYLINE و ارتفاع هدر و رأس‌ها در POLYLINE بررسی می‌شود؛ هندسه دارای Z غیرصفر یا نامعتبر با هشدار NON-XY POLYLINE کنار گذاشته می‌شود و هندسه XY بدون تغییر وارد می‌شود.

history.phase: جلوگیری از تبدیل بی‌هشدار منحنی‌های سه‌بعدی DXF به هندسه دوبعدی
history.summary: در ARC و CIRCLE ارتفاع مرکز (گروه 30) و در ELLIPSE ارتفاع مرکز و مؤلفه Z محور اصلی (گروه‌های 30 و 31) بررسی می‌شوند؛ مقادیر غیرصفر یا نامعتبر با هشدار NON-XY CURVE کنار گذاشته می‌شوند.

history.phase: جلوگیری از ورود بی‌هشدار بلوک‌های دارای ارتفاع در DXF
history.summary: در INSERT مؤلفه Z نقطه درج (گروه 30) بررسی می‌شود؛ مقدار غیرصفر یا نامعتبر با هشدار NON-XY INSERT کنار گذاشته می‌شود تا هندسه سه‌بعدی به‌اشتباه روی XY تصویر نشود.

history.phase: اصلاح جهت کمان بیضی با بردار نرمال منفی در DXF
history.summary: در ELLIPSE مؤلفه Z بردار نرمال بررسی و جهت محور فرعی با علامت آن تنظیم می‌شود تا کمان‌های بیضی با نرمال منفی روی سمت نادرست رسم نشوند؛ بردارهای نرمال غیرمعتبر با هشدار NON-XY OCS کنار گذاشته می‌شوند.

history.phase: رفع توقف کامل اجرای ویور به‌دلیل خطای نحوی
history.summary: پرانتز جاافتاده در ساخت لایه کابل DXF اصلاح و نسخه نمایشی و کش هماهنگ شد.

history.phase: بهبود رابط تب‌های DXF و واحد پیش‌فرض
history.summary: تب‌های اطلاعات فایل و آبجکت‌ها واضح شدند؛ واحد اولیه سانتی‌متر و ضریب ۱ و توضیح مختصات CAD تثبیت شد.
تشخیص با ورود به تب آبجکت‌ها و تغییر ورودی‌های واحد/لایه/برش خودکار تازه می‌شود؛ بدون تغییر موتور تشخیص یا تبدیل هندسه.
بهبود جانمایی تصاویر، Z-index قابل تنظیم، چرخش ۱۸۰ درجه و خطوط تفکیک خصوصیات.

history.phase: محافظت از ترتیب نمایش تصاویر پس‌زمینه
history.summary: جلوگیری از قرارگیری ناخواسته تصاویر پس‌زمینه روی خطوط CAD پس از افزودن Z-index.

history.phase: رفع انتظار نامحدود در بازیابی مرورگر
history.summary: در صورت مسدودشدن حذف پایگاه داده بازیابی، وعده بازیابی با نتیجه ناموفق پایان می‌یابد تا صف ذخیره آینه معلق نماند.
قفل ذخیره rd_last، بسته بازیابی و انتخاب آگاهانه نسخه آینه یا نقشه جاری.
موقعیت ذخیره‌شده جزئیات تجهیزات بدون enabled را معتبر شناختم؛ اعتبارسنجی مقادیر نامعتبر حفظ شد.

history.phase: اصلاح پیش‌نمایش DXF و کادرهای تشخیص
history.summary: کادرهای تشخیص تجهیزات دیگر خودکار روی نقشه نمی‌مانند؛ نمایش آن‌ها اختیاری و مستقل از هندسه اصلی است.

history.phase: اصلاح هندسه تجهیزات پس از DXF Import
history.summary: تخت و دیگر تجهیزات شناسایی‌شده هندسه اصلی CAD را در قالب آبجکت قابل‌ویرایش حفظ می‌کنند؛ جایگزینی SVG عمومی حذف شد.

history.phase: رفع توقف سراسری درج آبجکت روی بوم
history.summary: اصلاح انتساب اشتباه نوع آبجکت و محافظت مهاجرت تجهیزات از kind غیررشته‌ای؛ تست رگرسیون درج جعبه ابزار تقویت شد.

history.change: تغییر سراسری نمایش پورت‌ها و جزئیات محصول روی تجهیزات و لایه‌های قفل‌شده را مسدود کردم.
حذف پاک‌سازی خودکار داده، حفاظت نسخه‌های مهاجرت و بازیابی، قفل نویسنده مرورگر، تکمیل Revision و اصلاح زیرساخت آزمون
پاک‌سازی ناخواسته شورتکات‌های ذخیره‌شده در اولین بازشدن برنامه را برطرف کردم و نسخه را هماهنگ کردم.
اصلاح تصمیم مهاجرت Revision دارای نشانگر نسخه قدیمی: نسخه صریح snapshot دیگر با وضعیت نسخه جاری سند والد نادیده گرفته نمی‌شود؛ snapshots فاقد نشانگر همچنان وضعیت والد را به ارث می‌برند.
لغو یا ازدست‌رفتن pointer capture در برش PDF دیگر تغییر نیمه‌تمام را ثبت نمی‌کند؛ بازگردانی کادر قبلی و هماهنگ‌سازی کش ماژول PDF و شناسه‌های نسخه انجام شد.
ترمیم وضعیت rd_last پس از شکست ذخیره Revision، جلوگیری از بازنویسی Journal معلق و توقف ادامه ذخیره بر پایه آرشیو منقضی؛ ثبت checkpoint و فهرست پایدار رگرسیون و پروتکل نویسنده انحصاری.
اعتبارسنجی کامل Journal و حفظ رکوردهای ناقص؛ حفاظت اطلاعات بازیابی در شکست پاک‌سازی و rollback، توقف autosave و مهاجرت تا تعیین‌تکلیف بازیابی؛ تکمیل بسته خروجی و تطبیق مالک Journal در callback آینه.
جلوگیری از بسته‌شدن پنجره واردکننده PDF هنگام Commit ناهم‌زمان و جلوگیری از بازشدن واردکننده دوم پیش از پایان عملیات؛ حفظ بستن اجباری پس از موفقیت و تفکیک لغو پیش از Commit.

records.user_statement:
# HANDOFF — Room Designer V84
## Desktop UI Design Alignment

**Repository:** `salesnspelectronics-create/RoomDesigner`  
**Branch:** `main`  
**Last known version:** V83  
**Target version:** V84  
**Priority:** HIGH — Desktop UI/UX  
**Reference:** Three screenshots supplied in the Room Designer conversation, especially the previously AI-designed desktop workspace mockup.

### Mission

As a Senior UI/UX Engineer and Frontend Developer, redesign the existing Room Designer desktop interface to closely match the approved reference mockup.

The existing V83 interface must be upgraded visually, not merely recolored. Preserve the underlying SVG drawing engine, existing document model, tools, history, saving, and mobile interactions.

Before editing, inspect the current HEAD, existing code, and `project-evolution.json`. Do not overwrite other contributors' work.

### 1. Desktop Application Header

Implement a professional application menu bar matching the reference:

- فایل — File
- ویرایش — Edit
- نمایش — View
- پروژه — Project
- ابزارها — Tools
- تنظیمات — Settings
- راهنما — Help

Include Undo/Redo, Save Project, and clear product/version identification.

All menu actions must invoke existing functions where available. Do not introduce nonfunctional decorative controls.

### 2. Right-Side Toolbox

Replace the current vertically stacked text-button presentation with the reference's compact, icon-based grid cards.

Requirements:
- Persistent search field with immediate filtering
- Consistent SVG icons, legible Persian labels
- Architecture, Cabling, and Equipment categories
- Visually distinct colored category indicators
- Expandable/collapsible sections
- Selected tool highlighting
- Functional selection of existing tools
- No secondary full-screen modal when an existing tool can be accessed directly from Toolbox

Avoid inventing unsupported CAD tools simply to match the visual reference.

### 3. Left-Side Layers & Properties

Create a professional sidebar matching the reference.

**Layers & Groups**
- Tree-style hierarchy for architectural shapes, equipment, cables and existing groups
- Expand/collapse nodes
- Select a drawing object from the tree
- Where supported by the existing model, display working visibility and locking controls
- Do not imply full layer-management functionality if it is not implemented

**Properties**
- Contextual fields for the selected item
- Position, dimensions, rotation and relevant styling where applicable
- Proper right-to-left text alignment
- Functional editing through existing model operations
- Read-only labels where editing is not yet supported

### 4. Bottom Desktop Status Bar

Add a slim status bar containing:
- Zoom percentage
- Zoom In / Zoom Out
- Pan and Fit View
- Snap status
- Cursor X / Y coordinates
- Drawing units, without incorrectly claiming a calibrated real-world scale

### 5. Visual System

Use:
- Consistent Vazirmatn Persian typography with appropriate fallback
- High-contrast professional dark-blue panels
- Compact, readable SVG icon buttons
- Harmonized borders, spacing, hover, focus, disabled and selected states
- Consistent RTL and mixed Persian/English presentation
- Resizable and collapsible side panels

The Canvas should remain visually dominant.

### 6. Mobile Compatibility

Do not replace the mobile UI with the desktop layout.

Preserve mobile-specific touch interactions, Bottom Sheets, Floating Menu, pinch zoom and device-selection workflows.

Any shared CSS changes must be regression-checked at mobile viewport sizes.

### 7. Scope Restrictions

This release is exclusively focused on **desktop UI alignment**.

Do not independently rewrite the SVG rendering engine, routing, geometry snapping, grouping model, PDF export, database/storage or history implementation.

Avoid unrelated refactoring and feature expansion.

### 8. Verification and Acceptance Criteria

- Desktop layout visually matches the approved mockup as closely as practical.
- Right Toolbox uses searchable icon cards rather than the previous long text-button layout.
- Left sidebar contains Layers/Groups and Properties.
- Top navigation and bottom status bar are present and functional.
- Existing tools continue to work.
- Panel collapse, resize and scrolling function correctly.
- Mobile view remains usable.
- No horizontal overflow or obstructed Canvas interaction.
- JavaScript syntax and available tests pass.
- Browser/runtime checks are reported separately from static checks.

### 9. Versioning and GitHub

1. Verify the latest version and HEAD before changes.
2. Work only on the existing `main` branch.
3. Do not force-push.
4. Increment the existing version to V84 only if V83 remains the latest version.
5. Keep source version and Project Evolution aligned.
6. Record implementation scope, limitations and verification status in `project-evolution.json`.
7. Commit and Push the changes.
8. Provide commit SHA, published URL and a concise change report.

### 10. Final Delivery

At completion provide:
- Before/after desktop screenshots where browser testing is available
- List of completed design changes
- List of incomplete or unsupported features
- JavaScript/build/test results
- Mobile regression status
- GitHub commit SHA
- Project Evolution confirmation
- Runtime verification status

**Important:** Do not classify untested UI interactions as runtime-verified.

**End of handoff.**
Clarification: تصویر اول، تصویر نهایی کار باشد؛ منوهای آیکونی بزرگ و زیبا، نه صرفاً تغییر رنگ تصویر دوم. فقط کارهای خواسته‌شده انجام شود و سؤال ضروری پیش از اقدام پرسیده شود.

analyses.title: Rendering strategy
analyses.assessment: Use a reusable semantic document model independent of rendering package. Evaluate JointJS Community and Konva.js against connection, routing, render, React embeddability and license before changing core architecture.

analyses.title: Interface taxonomy
analyses.assessment: Separate communication type, connector type, physical cable type, and device port. Port has stable identity, display color, placement side and attachment capacity. RS-485 is an interface, not a connector.

analyses.title: Documents and history
analyses.assessment: Each portable document holds current drawing and all revision snapshots in JSON. Names are not identity, documentId is stable. Restore must append new revision. Local Browser Storage is not shared server storage.

analyses.title: Offline vs shared persistence
analyses.assessment: GitHub Pages serves read-only static app; direct file writes require server API on IIS. Do not add this backend until migration is requested. Admin-only deletion must be implemented server-side.

analyses.title: Vector symbols security
analyses.assessment: SVG only; sanitize against scripts, event handlers, external references, foreignObject and risky URLs. Bitmap wrapping is not vectorization. True raster-to-vector is future feature and must be assessed for reliability.

analyses.title: Mobile touch fidelity
analyses.assessment: Two-stage category/device picker, double tap for Properties, dragging object, drag-to-connect with snap near ports, PWA/mobile Safari tests. Test on iPhone; syntax validation does not establish gesture correctness.

analyses.title: GitHub Pages cache/version
analyses.assessment: User saw stale v0.4 after deployments; cache-busting URL and UI version must be updated with each code release. GitHub Pages build/deploy latency remains.

analyses.title: V62 senior source audit and remediation handoff
analyses.scope: Static review of standalone main branch; no runtime/browser, build, or device acceptance performed.

findings.finding: Revision snapshot omits walls while Restore assigns snapshot.walls||[]; restoring any saved revision can erase the architectural plan.
findings.recommended_implementation: Include walls and all document geometry in versioned snapshots; migrate legacy snapshots without silently clearing missing fields; restore into a candidate document and save a new revision only after validation.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Create walls and devices, save two revisions, restore the older revision; assert wall geometry persists. Restore a legacy snapshot without walls and assert explicit handling rather than deletion.

findings.finding: safeStorage.setItem swallows localStorage failures while saveLocal announces success; quota/private-storage failures can lose work after reload.
findings.recommended_implementation: Return a persistence result, show failure prominently, keep unsaved status, offer immediate .roomplan export; avoid treating in-memory fallback as durable.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Force QuotaExceededError and SecurityError; save and reload; verify no success claim and recoverable export.

findings.finding: Import accepts only array-shaped devices/cables, replaces the live document before validating nested device/port/cable geometry and references, and does not guarantee a recoverable prior state.
findings.recommended_implementation: Validate schema, IDs, finite coordinates/sizes, port arrays and cable endpoints; normalize supported legacy formats; stage candidate data before commit and preserve current document on any failure.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Import malformed ports, missing cable endpoints, NaN/huge geometry, incompatible schema and valid legacy/current files; assert existing document remains intact on rejection.

findings.finding: DXF export omits walls, flattens rotated devices to axis-aligned boxes, and may output raw cable waypoints rather than rendered orthogonal/offset paths.
findings.recommended_implementation: Build export from shared resolved geometry, include walls/rotation/routing, and explicitly document metadata that DXF cannot represent.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Compare rendered plan and parsed DXF for walls, rotated door/symbol, orthogonal cable and offset cable.

findings.finding: Locked devices cannot drag but remain editable, duplicable and deletable through quick actions and property actions.
findings.recommended_implementation: Define whether lock means all mutations or only transforms; enforce it in a central command guard with deliberate unlock action and visible feedback.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Lock a device then try drag, resize, rotate, property edit, duplicate and delete through both menus; assert agreed behavior and Undo.

findings.finding: Every pointer movement invokes full SVG replaceChildren and synchronous JSON serialization/localStorage write through render/saveAuto.
findings.recommended_implementation: Separate render from persistence; schedule rendering with requestAnimationFrame and debounce durable saves on committed mutations; retain flush on pagehide/visibility as feasible.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Profile drag/pan/pinch on representative 100/500 object documents on mobile Safari; verify persisted final geometry after reload.

findings.finding: Print forces a 0 0 960 680 viewBox regardless of document bounds or current view, potentially clipping off-canvas geometry.
findings.recommended_implementation: Compute print bounds from resolved document geometry, apply margins and fitting, and expose current-view versus whole-drawing choice if both are needed.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Place walls/devices outside initial 960×680, generate print/PDF, verify every intended object is visible.

analyses.architecture_recommendation: Before expanding to a reusable engine, separate document model/schema, commands with Undo/lock guard, geometry resolution, render adapters, persistence and export adapters. Keep browser UI independent of the core. Evaluate existing libraries and licenses against explicit requirements before migration; do not replace the renderer merely for structure.

analyses.title: Corel embedded-font rejection and editable component backgrounds
analyses.root_cause: The supplied Corel SVG has @font-face src:url(#FontID0). The existing sanitizer rejected any URL in style content before removing embedded fonts, so the SVG never reached the component. The existing white SVG default was insufficient while uploads were rejected.
decisions: Discard font-face declarations before checking remaining class styles for unsafe URL/import/expression content; preserve whitelisted visual class declarations.
Keep embedded fonts and metadata removed; retain rejection of scripts, event handlers and external references.
Add backgroundColor to device properties, rendering and import validation; choose contrasting text color for devices without SVG.
Update upload status and background picker immediately so Save retains the white SVG default or user-chosen color.
Guard asynchronous SVG reads against selection/document changes or newly locked devices.
Apply this change on v133 main without altering the other chat active-layer highlight or symbol changes.

analyses.title: Reuse existing SVG paths; separate reusable engine, published assets, local drafts and document snapshots

decisions: Extract existing planLibrary and architectureSvg artwork into a 33-symbol published library with 40 mappings; preserve legacy fallback metadata.
Normalize both the image viewport and embedded SVG preserveAspectRatio; share layout and viewport clipping with DXF.
Use center-based rotation/flip coordinates for artwork, ports, cable endpoints and routing direction.
Persist original/current SVG snapshots, ID/version, crop and existing transforms so releases do not silently change saved drawings.
Apply draft assignments only to newly placed equipment; expose an export bundle and validated release helper.
Reject executable SVG elements, events, external resource URLs, entities and invalid import metadata.
Preserve genuine white elements in Auto Trim; allow explicit element deletion.
Respect user follow-up: stop pursuing local browser launch and do not enable automatic browser CI.

analyses.title: Plan SVG default fit prevents proportional object bounds fill

Keep explicit fit/center/stretch modes for user customization.
Apply same mode in DXF and property controls.

analyses.title: Cable route retains old endpoint bends after port-side edits

decisions: Generate exit stubs from current port sides at both ends.
Filter stored bends inside either device clearance region.
Persist manual bends rather than auto-generated path geometry for new cables.
Keep legacy documents readable; require runtime testing for dense layouts.

analyses.title: Selection overlay bypasses layer visibility filter

decisions: Apply layerVisible to device selection handles.
Apply effective visibility to wall shape corner overlays.
Suppress cable draft anchor indicators for hidden devices.
Preserve selection state so unhiding a layer restores its selection.

analyses.title: Resize selection handles too visually similar to device ports
analyses.root_cause: Selection handles were rendered as opaque 12x12 orange-outlined squares, matching the size and square shape of colored device ports.
decisions: Reduce selection handles to 7 screen pixels at all zoom levels.
Set selection handle fill and outline opacity to 55%.
Reduce selected device outline width and opacity.
Retain a 12 screen pixel mouse hit radius so handles remain operable.

analyses.title: Missing object context menu and toolbar rotation
analyses.root_cause: No contextmenu listener for drawing objects and desktop shortcut bar had no rotation actions.
decisions: Intercept browser context menu only on drawing objects in desktop layout.
Show Copy/Cut/Duplicate/Delete and applicable Rotate/Ungroup actions.
Use existing checkpoint, save and render flow for rotation.
Disable rotate toolbar controls unless editable device is selected.

analyses.title: Improve desktop object and cable editing affordances

decisions: Add distinct icons and full rotate labels.
Show diagonal resize cursor at editable device corners.
Expose generated orthogonal bends and convert them into editable waypoints when dragged.

analyses.title: Actuator labels and snapping
analyses.root_cause: Desktop property panel omitted showLabel; SVG label renderer was gated by d.svg only; wall snap rejected all port-equipped devices; device drag lacked grid snap.
decisions: Expose showLabel as a desktop property checkbox.
Render labels under artwork for both embedded and library SVG assets.
Remove blanket exclusion of port-equipped devices from wall snapping.
Snap dragged devices to 20-unit grid when enabled and no wall snap applies.

analyses.title: Architectural wall right-click fallback
analyses.root_cause: Architectural wall paths are drawn with pointer-events:none and no data-kind attributes, so event-target selector misses them and browser context menu appears.
decisions: Intercept contextmenu at canvas boundary in desktop layout.
Resolve walls via existing geometric hit-testing.
Keep multi-selection intact when right-clicking one of its members.

decisions: Keep each object in original layer.
Add collapsible group headings and chain icons for grouped objects.
Track groupId in render signature and preserve expansion.

decisions: Use Show Name / Hide Name contextual command with checkbox icon.
Apply only to selected editable device.
Reuse existing label renderer and save history.

analyses.title: Blocked sessionStorage aborts startup layout setup
analyses.root_cause: setDesktopLayout() read sessionStorage.getItem('rd_layout') without a guard. Storage denial throws and prevents setupDesktopWorkspace() from returning to the startup-ready assignment.
decisions: Wrap sessionStorage access in try/catch; absent preference is the fallback.
Keep desktop eligibility and existing mobile preference semantics unchanged.
Preserve V155–V227 historical ledger gap explicitly rather than fabricate entries.

analyses.title: Stale reads following localStorage quota-denied mutations
analyses.root_cause: Failed writes only updated fallbackStore; getItem still preferred readable but stale localStorage. Failed removals likewise exposed deleted keys.
decisions: Shadow localStorage for keys whose most recent write or removal failed.
Clear the volatile shadow on successful persistent mutations; preserve normal external updates.
Keep IndexedDB recovery and existing persistence warnings unchanged.
remaining_risks: Volatile fallback does not survive reload; export warning remains necessary.

Expand an existing group into real device/cable IDs and unique wall shape IDs before modifier toggles.
Preserve all groupId values during visibility changes, including members on hidden layers.
Use actual UI clicks and canvas drag in browser regression; cover mixed cross-layer members and history.

analyses.decision: Explicit routing ownership replaces the former autoRouting-undefined behavior. A pure A* rectilinear router validates obstacles without a collision-scored fallback; visibility bounds include endpoint bodies and wall strokes. Direct lines always retain two endpoints. Manual edits capture rendered geometry and disable automatic routing. Dragging a leg shifts its adjacent corners instead of mixing virtual/stored vertex indexes. Mouse double-click detection no longer intercepts a second press intended for dragging.
analyses.remaining_risks: Manual direct/free routes follow user choices and can intentionally cross items; collision avoidance applies to generated routes. Conservatively inflated rotated bounds or overlapping devices can produce a blocked-route warning, and a resource cap also fails safely. Physical laptop/mobile acceptance and user review remain pending; version/commit/push remain deferred.

analyses.decision: Opt-in backtrack collapse applies only to safeRoute output. The collapsed collinear segment is contained in the previously validated legs, so removing the excursion does not introduce a new obstacle crossing. Handles and manual paths keep existing semantics.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime review pending; conservative obstacle bounds and blocked-route behavior unchanged. Release remains deferred until explicit push authorization.

Releasing Shift restores unrestricted dimensions from the same original frame.

analyses.remaining_risks: Manual user acceptance pending; Center mode and user-defined geometry retain existing semantics; release remains deferred.

analyses.decision: Relay side changes apply to defaults and preserve existing instances. Held movement starts after 250ms, runs at 80 units per second, Shift x10, with bounded 30Hz updates and capped elapsed time. analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending. Complex automatic connected routes can still cost work per frame. No release, push, reset or app version increment.

analyses.decision: Route mode changes are explicit user edits; blocked orthogonal conversion leaves the cable unchanged. Device rotation updates port positions through the existing transform pipeline. Cable labelRotation transforms only its text around its independently offset anchor. Print bounds include transformed labels and editor rotation controls are removed from SVG/PDF. Implicit quick-connect adds an endpoint-only trigger, while generated routes reuse the established safe router.
analyses.remaining_risks: Manual user acceptance pending. Arbitrary-angle device ports use the existing nearest-cardinal routing direction; conservative rotated-body bounds may block an automatic route, which fails safely. Explicit Direct may cross bodies by user choice. Release remains deferred.

analyses.decision: Right-click insertion targets the clicked cable even when it was grouped or part of a multi-selection, then selects that cable without removing group membership. The pointer coordinate is projected onto its real displayed segment. Existing port/bend points within four screen pixels are not duplicated. Saved autoRouting is disabled on manual insertion. Preserve cable DOM on clicks without motion so native double-click can reach the shared insertion handler; do not intercept a second mouse press intended for dragging.
analyses.remaining_risks: Manual user acceptance pending. Orthogonal vertex drags may add local corners to maintain right angles while preserving fixed neighboring anchors. Explicit manual edits follow user geometry; automatic collision avoidance retains existing behavior. No release authorization.

analyses.decision: Context menu identifies the clicked rendered vertex with screen-space tolerance and explicitly excludes endpoints. Removal materializes manual geometry and disables automatic rerouting. An essential orthogonal corner uses the alternate local connector, then collinear/reversing points are simplified so the deleted corner is not regenerated. Mode conversions already use the safe simplified router or an empty direct waypoint list; new regression assertions enforce both cleanup requirements.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Orthogonal deletion can relocate a necessary corner and remove newly redundant corners to retain right angles. Manual deletion follows user edits; no automatic obstacle-free claim is added for manually adjusted geometry. Release remains deferred.

analyses.decision: Use a native SVG illustration rather than embedding a PNG. Draw the coil housing as a path so the frame-crop heuristic cannot select its inner rectangle and clip the pipe marks. analyses.remaining_risks: Manual user acceptance pending. Already placed old fan icons remain usable independently of the replacement default catalog. Source version and publication remain deferred.

analyses.decision: Keep lighting and request controls in one six-slot product rather than duplicating models or introducing mounting choices. Base code CR-3R-3L plus existing Atlas suffix AT yields exact requested code. Fixed SVG uses reusable native logo artwork and pocket geometry; two new scoped lighting vectors reproduce vanity and ceiling-shade symbols. Product identity and real ratio are catalog-defined.
analyses.remaining_risks: Reference reconstruction is vector artwork; user visual acceptance pending. No ports added.

analyses.decision: Use combined-panel type with bedside-6r family and fixed Almas model. Four catalog mounting IDs carry socket-position names and rotations; explicit per-mount assets/layouts retain upright icons and rotate socket geometry. Product identity/code remains unchanged. Toolbox insertion supports both default order and older saved section orders.
analyses.remaining_risks: Native vector reconstruction uses existing library service/lighting glyphs plus a new wall-light icon; user visual/runtime acceptance pending. Physical ports remain deferred.

analyses.decision: The prior SVGs used group rotation for socket geometry. Explicit rotated circle/rectangle coordinates make the required hole alignment intrinsic to every per-mount asset; editable command glyphs remain upright.
analyses.remaining_risks: User visual confirmation pending.

analyses.decision: Correct previous misinterpretation: all mounting choices display horizontal socket holes. Keep top/bottom physical placement and upright command icons unchanged.
analyses.remaining_risks: User visual acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Keep internal code mode/fields stable for saved-document compatibility; rename visible labels only. Attached detail is an owner property rather than a separate catalog item. Asset-derived aspect ratio and immutable real image persist across mode changes; details render only in code mode. Bounds for pages, fit and SVG/print export include visible details. Owner deletion/hiding/layer visibility and locks govern the attached detail. Drag has one checkpoint per gesture and prevents owner movement.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Manual dragging may intentionally overlap objects. Automatic placement uses the exterior of the current visible plan bounding box; sparse/large plans can place details outside the current viewport. Future alternate detail artwork remains deferred.

analyses.decision: Use locally bundled Mozilla PDF.js with local worker, CMaps, standard fonts and WASM resources. No CDN/upload. Rendering respects PDF page rotation. Preview/crop happens before document mutation; the selected batch is rasterized sequentially before one commit to in-memory drawing with one Undo checkpoint. Existing image objects provide proportional resizing, movement, layering/locks and export persistence. Original PDF bytes and vector object recognition are not persisted/imported.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Password-protected documents require an unencrypted copy. PDF input is capped at 80 MB; output has per-image storage limits and selectable rendering quality. Browser durable-storage limits continue to apply, with existing backup/export messaging. Native file selection is used over HTTP/GitHub Pages/local preview.

analyses.decision: Retain normalized crop data and rendering pipeline; change only direct manipulation UI. Eight pointer-captured handles support independent axes/corners, mouse/touch, move and resize cursors. Pointer cancellation restores the previous crop. Arrow keys provide 1-pixel/Shift-10-pixel adjustments for the focused crop or handle.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Edge handles may be partially clipped at full-page bounds but remain accessible.

analyses.decision: Keep the name, font and visibility on the owner rather than duplicating data on detailView. Determine above/below from the arrow entry edge. Include caption vertical extent in detail page/print bounds. Scoped dblclick selects only text/number-like fields, leaving checkboxes/colors unchanged.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Long captions follow existing single-line behavior.

analyses.decision: Reuse the generic panel catalog pipeline for hardware with zero configurable icon slots and a standard internal model; hide the internal model in product titles. Optional validated catalog partNumber provides exact hardware part numbers without invented model suffixes; existing devices retain generated model codes. Insert the new section for default and older saved toolbox orders. Keep future wiring and control mapping deferred.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime/visual acceptance pending. PT is a provisional part number because no power-terminal part number was specified. Internal standard model is not user-selectable.

analyses.decision: Use optional validated iconicBackgroundColor on catalog entries. Keep existing appearanceByMode overrides and code-mode defaults. Migrate the retired black hardware default once using iconicAppearanceVersion; leave deliberate non-black custom colors unchanged.
analyses.remaining_risks: User visual acceptance pending. Old explicit black customization cannot be distinguished from the retired default during the one-time upgrade.

analyses.decision: Keep active ports as the existing d.ports array to reuse all routing/hit testing/export/clipboard behavior. Define disabled templates in the central catalog and associate active ports by catalogPortId. Off is refused while cables are attached to prevent accidental cable deletion. Dense panel ports distribute within face bounds with smaller handles. Canonical type normalization maps old rs485_power IDs to rs485 without changing link/port IDs; current render does not scan revision history, and imports recursively normalize as required. Legacy relay auto-add ignores inactive templates. SVG/DXF color mappings use green RS-485.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Existing consumers retain their previous DO/DI ports because the request addresses semantic equipment families only. Port-position editing and logical control/event mapping remain deferred. Historical connection-model tests describe superseded physical catalogs; current behavior is covered by the focused active-port suite.

analyses.decision: New cableGeometryVersion=1 stores only manual waypoints and endpoints; routeMode/autoRouting/offset/reserve are removed from normalized cable data. Legacy rendering is evaluated once and frozen to preserve visible geometry; old reserve becomes dashed. New cables are always straight, superseding previous obstacle-routing defaults. Smart Ports can reorder anchors but never reroutes manual bends. Selection uses blue dashed overlay/nodes without changing underlying cable color/width or adding a bounding rectangle. Port side overrides persist by catalog definition ID and connected paths follow changed anchors. Locked cables guard side changes; endpoints stay attached to compatible ports.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Straight/manual geometry may cross devices, per the new explicit behavior. Historical route-mode tests target superseded features. Changing port side means the local side of the rotated device.

analyses.decision: Keep point indices stable during drag and compact geometry on release/cancel/focus loss. Merge the edited vertex with another vertex within 6 screen pixels, removing the intervening collapsed span; remove interior vertices within 2 screen pixels of their neighboring segment. Preserve anchored cable endpoints and line shape identity/style. One checkpoint per gesture supports Undo/Redo. Deletion compacts remaining segments as well.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Deliberately dragging a vertex onto a nonadjacent vertex collapses the intervening loop. Short segments within the merge tolerance can be collapsed intentionally.

analyses.decision: Global device visibility retains physical port IDs and connected cables while hiding port handles. On first show all catalog ports are instantiated; old partial activation expands to the complete definition. Explicit persisted cable animation is independent of selection. Shared angle snapping applies during dragging and immediately when Shift is pressed/released.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device runtime acceptance pending. Shift enforces the geometric angle between adjacent segments; a straightened bend is compacted on release. Flow is an SVG motion animation and is omitted from static print/SVG output.

analyses.decision: Label selection exits multi-selection and supports independent dragging/rotation. Text has no background stroke. Cable inspector contains both persistent visibility switches, text angle disables when text hidden, and export respects hidden labels.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device runtime acceptance pending. Shift enforces the geometric angle between adjacent segments; a straightened bend is compacted on release. Flow is an SVG motion animation and is omitted from static print/SVG output.

analyses.decision: Draft vertices are transient until port completion and persist as manual waypoints. Escape discards the draft without history/document changes. Type description is in the dot tooltip. Port locating uses two temporary browser animations in the original type color; hidden ports are temporarily indicated without toggling visibility or mutating the document. Existing cables do not block starting another connection at a port.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device acceptance pending. Synthetic touch pointer coverage is not physical mobile-device acceptance. Orthogonal snapping may add elbows to retain fixed anchors.

analyses.decision: Supersedes the RD-285 right-angle-circle decision. Snap to the applicable axis-aligned elbow, preferring compatibility with neighboring segments. For aligned anchors, preserve anchors and create two orthogonal elbows as needed. Frozen gesture base geometry keeps index handling stable when temporary vertices are inserted or removed.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device acceptance pending. Synthetic touch pointer coverage is not physical mobile-device acceptance. Orthogonal snapping may add elbows to retain fixed anchors.

analyses.decision: Compact snapped geometry immediately during Shift, including collinear vertices and coincident corners, for both lines and cables. A straight path shows just two endpoints and one insertion midpoint while the pointer is still held; release cleanup, Undo/Redo and subsequent edits remain supported.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device acceptance pending. Synthetic touch pointer coverage is not physical mobile-device acceptance. Orthogonal snapping may add elbows to retain fixed anchors.

analyses.decision: Use one shared polylineDragBasis captured before any document mutation, with frozen points and stable edited index. Stop lazy capture after initial segment subdivision and never reconstruct snap anchors from the current preview. General lines create preview segments from the frozen geometry after the first movement checkpoint, matching cables. Temporary insertion handles remain presentation only.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: The previous closest-angle rule chose a right-angle corner for a wide V even when the original endpoints were nearly aligned, leaving a tiny port-adjacent leg. A lone edited vertex now takes the straightening branch unconditionally with Shift; shared compaction removes it immediately. This supersedes right-angle snapping for that specific single-bend case.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending. Shift intentionally straightens a lone bend even if its included angle is closer to 90 degrees.

analyses.decision: Prior cleanup measured distance to a clamped segment and only removed an interior vertex when its projection lay between the neighbors. A reversal lies outside that interval, so old outward corners survived and doubled the stroke. Use perpendicular distance to the supporting line for collinearity, preserving endpoints; iterative cleanup removes forward runs, reversed runs and exact out-and-back triples. Applies to both real geometry and live Shift previews.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending. Deliberately overlapping backtracking segments are intentionally compacted, matching the requested line/cable behavior.

analyses.decision: Legacy Negin SVG artboards include large outer whitespace. effectiveArtwork already crops it for regular rendering, but detail rendering bypassed that function and used raw LightingModel artwork. A bounded transient cache now provides the cropped real artwork and its viewBox aspect ratio. Detail size and rendering share it; existing edge, caption and extent helpers use that same size. No asset or placed-object SVG duplication is introduced.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending. Existing detail x/y coordinates are retained, so a deliberately positioned detail outside the initial page still correctly expands the workspace.

analyses.decision: The former ratio-based width buckets (110 for square/landscape, 70 for portrait, 180 for wide) enlarged each category differently. Derive detail width and height directly from catalog-backed standard real dimensions at a uniform 1.4x scale, independent of instance resizing. This supersedes RD-293 detail sizing by cropped viewBox; cropped raw artwork itself remains shared with ordinary real rendering.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance pending. Existing detail x/y positions are retained while sizes now follow the common scale.

analyses.decision: Derive global checked states from all applicable devices instead of storing a separate global preference. Bulk actions use one checkpoint and refresh the inspector explicitly; the no-selection signature includes aggregate state to avoid stale controls. Share portsForDisplay between single-device editing, global display and insertion inheritance. Bulk display commands are explicit document-wide presentation actions; per-device lock flags and layers are retained. Port IDs and cables remain intact when hidden. Details placement preserves existing offsets or chooses a free location when absent.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending. Enabling all details may expand the canvas for newly placed detail images. New products inherit port display only; detail display is not inherited, so the aggregate details checkbox becomes unchecked after adding a product without details.

analyses.decision: Supersedes RD-291 unconditional straightening of an existing lone bend. polylineDragBasis now distinguishes insertion from re-grabbing: an existing lone bend receives a frozen Shift-specific basis using the two segment handles visible before pointerdown, while a separate free basis preserves normal drag behavior. Use a screen-space tolerance when classifying nearly aligned anchors so snapping does not produce tiny corner legs that erase those references. No preview-born handles are adopted mid-gesture.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending. Existing settled handles are promoted into geometry only when required by the new Shift gesture; normal free dragging does not add vertices.

analyses.decision: Replace accumulated inline special cases with a DOM-independent shared editor and property-based checks. The audit found stale numeric edit indices on final cleanup, nonadjacent collinear overlap loops, incomplete cancellation/history handling, no-op history entries and noneditable closed lines. Merge against the frozen basis during preview; final cleanup is index-independent. Roll back complete edit checkpoints for Escape/cancellation and remove unchanged transactions. Shift draft routing is axis-constrained and preserves the final port exactly. Keep proper geometric crossings separate from electrical connections. Existing RD-296 lifecycle rules remain in force.
analyses.remaining_risks: Physical mobile-device acceptance is pending; browser touch coverage is synthetic. Deep overlap normalization can be quadratic and runs on release for paths longer than 200 points; preview uses bounded cleanup on those larger paths. Deliberate collinear self-overlap is removed by design. Validation is systematic but is not proof over every possible user sequence.

analyses.decision: Supersedes the completeness implied by RD-297 overlap coverage: prior tests checked exact-axis retraces, counts and idempotence but missed almost-collinear reversals. The endpoint chord becomes short on a return stroke, exaggerating a small endpoint offset; exact deep-overlap checks cannot repair it. Use an independent incoming-segment return test with the existing screen merge tolerance, retaining endpoints and aligning an adjacent orthogonal corner. Apply in both preview and commit through the common line/cable engine. Add an independent no-return oracle and offset/rotation/reversal fixtures.
analyses.remaining_risks: Within six screen pixels an adjacent near-collinear reversal is intentionally collapsed; close but separate parallel legs are not joined. Physical device and user acceptance remain pending. Finite tests do not prove all possible paths.

analyses.decision: Normalize empty multi-selection centrally before inspector signatures, quick controls and overlays are computed. This covers blank click, empty marquee and removing the last selected member, rather than hiding only the inspector message.
analyses.remaining_risks: Nonempty multiple selections retain the existing message; shared multi-object editing remains deferred.

analyses.decision: Use actual getBBox edge and center instead of an assumed half-width/baseline, rotate that anchor with the label, and reduce fixed screen offset from 25 to 14 pixels. Preserve the existing icon and hit target dimensions.
analyses.remaining_risks: Physical touch-device acceptance remains pending; device rotation handles are unchanged.

analyses.decision: Catalog entry portPolicy=configurable is authoritative. Per-instance ports carry stable catalogPortId and id; devicePortDefinitions adapts these to the existing editor rather than adding duplicate arrays. Hiding preserves connections and IDs. Refuse removing connected ports. Validate custom types, side mappings and unique definition IDs on import. The real artwork wraps an optimized JPEG copy of the supplied photo in one referenced SVG library asset; the SVG sanitizer permits only embedded PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 images and continues rejecting external sources and embedded SVG. Fixed equipment retains catalog-defined ports.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device acceptance pending; connections must be removed before deleting their port. Existing browser storage limits apply; photo data is shared in the library, not copied into product instances.

analyses.decision: Use catalog-driven EP without migration special cases. Store reusable form defaults in UI memory, not product port definitions or document history. Default selectors update on valid owned change events. Existing deletion connection/lock guards remain unchanged.
analyses.remaining_risks: Session form defaults reset on full reload; user acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Use ordinary cable metadata, not extra electrical connections or editable breakpoints. One strand has no marker; 2..99 render exact-count ticks, with spacing compressed to fit short segments. Marker strokes stay solid even on dashed cables. Shared geometry keeps keyboard preview and DXF aligned. Validate integer range on UI/import and inherit metadata through existing copy/history serialization.
analyses.remaining_risks: Marker placement is automatic on the longest segment; independent dragging of the marker is not part of this request. User acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Use the existing PDF options flow; no native print action occurs until the existing prepare-output action. Prevent defaults even for repeated shortcut events.
analyses.remaining_risks: Physical OS/browser integration acceptance remains with user.

analyses.decision: Preserve CSS font-face rules and imported font stylesheets in the independent blob/downloaded print HTML; normalize relative font URLs to absolute URLs so blob base resolution cannot break them. Use computed font family rather than a fixed fallback stack. Replace the fixed 500ms print delay with actual font readiness and two animation frames.
analyses.remaining_risks: Remote webfonts retain their source availability/cache requirements, like the main page. Font unavailable at source falls back through the same font stack. Browser/physical printer acceptance remains pending.

analyses.decision: Scope styling to border-property/border-controls/color-picker classes so other appearance controls remain unchanged. Use the original native color input, not a new popup/event path; the decorative SVG ignores pointer events. Preserve data attributes for live editing, ownership, locks and model-specific border policies.
analyses.remaining_risks: Native color dialog appearance is browser-dependent; the compact control itself uses the application dark theme. User acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Use hidden containers for checkbox-dependent controls, preserving values and data attributes for ownership/history. Disable hidden inputs too. Shared RTL flex layout puts color at physical left and size takes remaining width. labelColor is validated at document import and copied/history-serialized normally. Update caption fill directly during color gestures to avoid full-canvas rerender on every input. Regular, door/fallback and relocated detail captions share the same ink. Print/SVG retain the fill attributes.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device acceptance pending. Model-defined automatic frames remain automatic; unchecked/disabled checkboxes still follow their existing model policies.

analyses.decision: Pair only spatial controls, keeping line thickness/length semantics unchanged. Numeric keys and ownership guards remain intact, with the same original-page top-left origin. Use direction:ltr on the paired region inside RTL property rows; field label remains at right. Room text receives twice the flexible space of font size; color stays fixed at left.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device acceptance pending; narrow-screen layout needs normal visual review.

analyses.decision: Replace 2:1 proportional text sizing with a fixed 56px text basis; the number control remains flexible. No data model or validation changes.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Do not overwrite persisted preferences simply because a mode cannot display them. Derive effective checkbox state from applicability: all independent styling/callout features off and disabled for real mode; part number and callout off and disabled in iconic mode; automatic Azin frame checked/readonly; Negin/Almas fallback outline retains existing conditional color editability. Code mode restores user choices. Use the existing compact-control hiding mechanism based on effective checked state.
analyses.remaining_risks: User/device acceptance pending. New product types with additional display capabilities must extend the shared state policy rather than ad hoc UI checks.

analyses.decision: Share CSS grid measurements with the X/Y row to maintain alignment without fixed pixel offsets or resize listeners. Invisible pseudo-element labels reserve the axis column widths.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Correct RD-311 alignment interpretation using W/H grid metrics and a two-column input span. Preserve integer editing and locks.
analyses.remaining_risks: User acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Extend placeNewDevice and insertion factories with an optional explicit center instead of relocating an already-added object or creating a second history step. Share built/plan architecture factories between sheet, desktop click and drop. Trusted in-memory descriptors plus a custom drag MIME prevent arbitrary external payloads from invoking creation. Resolve catalog objects at drop time; ignore drags from a replaced document. Native dragend/Escape clean preview state; real new pointerdown clears suppression of stray source clicks. Respect active-layer locks and existing growth guards. General straight lines use the actual center ordinate.
analyses.remaining_risks: Native HTML drag/drop behavior depends on browser/input support; desktop Chromium tested. Touch users retain click/tap insertion. Edge auto-pan while dragging from toolbox is not included. User acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Promote the accumulated V277 pending work to the current source release at explicit user request. Historical pending-release records remain unchanged; this entry supersedes their release-request status. No feature behavior or Git state is changed.
analyses.remaining_risks: User must commit and push; previous user runtime acceptance and historical audit caveats remain pending.

analyses.decision: Preserve context-menu-only locking and existing lock protection. Do not auto-unlock or delete old reference layers. New DXF imports are editable/grouped, use known header unit defaults, and receive a fitted camera. Confirmed layer deletion retains its existing ownership/dependency cleanup.
analyses.remaining_risks: Existing incorrectly declared sample files must be replaced by the corrected cm sample or explicitly imported with factor 1. New import grouping can be undone or ungrouped. Browser acceptance pending; baseline test harness failures remain.

analyses.decision: Use optional labelPosition enum (top/bottom), preserve legacy placement when absent, disable editing for hidden names and locked objects. Include captions in print bounds.
analyses.remaining_risks: User browser/mobile acceptance pending. Website deployment is separate.

analyses.decision: Preserve existing remote V278 DXF release and all historical records. Integrate caption placement and rotation under V279-N. Derive unique record IDs from existing records; no force push. User explicitly requested all project branches merged into main and feature/fix suffixes N/R.
analyses.remaining_risks: User runtime acceptance and online deployment completion remain pending.

analyses.decision: Use bounded local ASCII parsing with LINE/LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE, sampled bulges/arcs/circles/ellipses and transformed nested INSERT blocks. Unsupported types and tilted OCS are reported. Stage layer/crop/unit changes without mutating the drawing; unknown units require explicit selection. Native conversion has one Undo checkpoint and preserves source layer identity. Crop splits disconnected source contours to avoid false editable connections.
analyses.remaining_risks: DXF is reference geometry rather than a complete CAD semantic importer; text, hatches, splines, meshes and unsupported entities are reported/omitted. Up to 80 MiB ASCII input, 200k expanded preview segments and 20k segments per import. Curves are approximated; user project acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Use local heuristic proposals rather than claiming general visual understanding. Semantic INSERT metadata and connected geometry/layer/dimension rules propose objects; none is selected automatically. Units/layers/crop changes clear stale approvals. Recompute approved bounds from exact selected segments, replace only disjoint source indices and preserve native layers/grouping. Default unknown units to cm while honoring supported INSUNITS. Reuse the existing file dispatcher and confirmation for Ctrl+N/O.
analyses.remaining_risks: Recognition may miss or misclassify symbols; human confirmation required. Geometry inference <=5000 selected segments and <=100 visible proposals. Native symbols preserve footprint and cardinal rotation, not every CAD detail or hinge handedness. Browsers can reserve Ctrl+N/O outside page-controlled contexts. User acceptance pending. Two existing equipment-count test failures remain documented, not silently fixed.

analyses.decision: Use Ctrl+Alt+N for new drawing in browser tabs. Chromium BrowserCommandController browser test explicitly reserves Ctrl+N. A DOM preventDefault handler cannot guarantee receipt of a reserved accelerator. Preserve Ctrl+O and avoid unrelated UX changes.
analyses.remaining_risks: Extensions or operating system mappings can intercept alternate combinations; real Windows Chrome acceptance pending. Prior V281 Ctrl+N browser-support claim is corrected, not treated as confirmed.

analyses.decision: Use explicit fixed cm/1 staging defaults with mismatch notice rather than header override. Toilet inference stays unchecked and reviewable. Persist view toggles as document settings, preserving native source colors and individual product modes. Reuse live mode dispatcher for context-menu actions and supported-mode/lock guards. Global detail layouts live at document level, leaving locked device properties untouched.
analyses.remaining_risks: Toilet heuristic can misclassify similarly shaped sanitary fixtures; confirm proposals. Color mode uses DXF layer colors and colored native object outlines, not complete CAD appearance semantics. Detail artwork exists for catalog-supported products; custom unsupported images are excluded. User desktop acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Shared caption coordinate/anchor helper for four sides. Unique native radio group names prevent desktop/mobile inspector controls from interfering. Context submenu dispatches to the matching radio input using the established live-property guard.
analyses.remaining_risks: Caption sides are in the object local coordinate frame and follow existing object rotation. Real user project acceptance pending.

analyses.decision: Treat the user final instruction as authorization to implement the accumulated runtime batch, after earlier hold. Leader routing reuses bounded orthogonal geometry, excludes decorative DXF furniture/door linework, avoids other product boxes and architectural wall/window segments, and never draws a fallback crossing path. Object placement is kept manual. Apply layer ink to SVG strokes, preserving fills and avoiding box overlays. Default selection is an explicit user-directed policy change from V281 conservative defaults; geometry edits clear stale proposals before reanalysis.
analyses.remaining_risks: Orthogonal routing uses conservative segment bounding rectangles; dense, enclosed or limit-exceeding geometry can return blocked and omit the leader. An attachment point lying inside a wall is treated as an endpoint connection. Detail images themselves can still be manually placed over geometry. Vanity inference uses dimensions and nearby chair context and can misclassify; review default-selected proposals before importing. Older document colors remain as stored.

analyses.decision: فقط اصلاح تگ ناقص واحد میلی‌متر در انتخاب‌گر DXF؛ عدم تغییر پیش‌فرض سانتی‌متر، محاسبات ضریب یا رفتار ورود نقشه. نسخهٔ V285-R با یک Commit واحد و پیام فارسی.
analyses.remaining_risks: تأیید انتخاب میلی‌متر در مرورگر و مقیاس نقشه پس از Import بر عهدهٔ کاربر است؛ ممیزی مخزن کامل نیست و تست خودکار عمداً اجرا نشد.

analyses.decision: اصلاح محدود خطای نحوی فراخوانی coloredLayer(exportLayer(...),color) در خروجی کابل DXF بدون تغییر منطق رنگ یا نام‌گذاری لایه؛ نسخه V308-R.
analyses.remaining_risks: تأیید راه‌اندازی واقعی در Chrome و خروجی DXF کابل پس از انتشار GitHub Pages بر عهده کاربر است. Build و آزمون مرورگر اجرا نشد.

analyses.decision: مرحله اول فقط شفاف‌سازی تب‌های ورود DXF و واحد پیش‌فرض؛ الگوریتم تشخیص آبجکت و جایگزینی هندسه در این مرحله دست‌نخورده بماند.
analyses.remaining_risks: انتخاب واحد صحیح در فایل‌های CAD با INSUNITS متفاوت باید کاربر تأیید کند؛ تشخیص خودکار آبجکت‌ها و حفظ هندسه نیازمند اصلاح مستقل است.

analyses.decision: در مرحله دوم فقط orchestration تحلیل خودکار DXF تغییر می‌کند؛ پیشنهادهای تشخیص تا زمان ورود نهایی صرفاً staged باقی می‌مانند.
analyses.remaining_risks: صحت تشخیص هندسی و حفظ هندسه در تبدیل آبجکت خارج از دامنه مرحله دوم است؛ تست مرورگر نیازمند اجرای محیط Playwright است.

analyses.decision: اصلاحات مستقل در یک نسخه با checkpoint و ذخیره موجود انجام شد؛ موتور DXF دست‌نخورده ماند.
analyses.remaining_risks: جانمایی بیرونی بر اساس bounding box کل نقشه است و برای چند اتاق پیچیده به بازبینی نیاز دارد؛ تست مرورگر هنوز اجرا نشده.

analyses.decision: حفظ سازگاری ترتیب پس‌زمینه تصاویر هنگام معرفی Z-index؛ تغییرات DXF همچنان ممنوع.
analyses.remaining_risks: تست مرورگر برای روی‌هم‌افتادگی چند تصویر و انتخاب آبجکت لازم است.

analyses.decision: پذیرش نبود enabled در detailView، بدون بازنویسی فایل کاربران یا تضعیف کنترل نوع داده؛ بازگشت به نقشه اصلی پس از بارگذاری V316-R.
analyses.remaining_risks: تأیید بازیابی و نمایش تجهیزات در مرورگر کاربر هنوز انجام نشده؛ پیش از آن داده rd_last و IndexedDB پاک نشود.

analyses.decision: عدم تغییر اندازه یا داده‌های DXF؛ رفع اثر بصری کادرهای تشخیص با نمایش opt-in و بازنشانی هنگام تعویض تب.
analyses.remaining_risks: تأیید بصری روی فایل واقعی کاربر و بررسی تطابق شکل آبجکت‌های تبدیل‌شده پس از ورود نهایی هنوز لازم است؛ جایگزینی SVG با هندسه CAD یک موضوع مستقل است.

analyses.decision: هندسه CAD برای آبجکت‌های واردشده منبع حقیقت است؛ از SVG عمومی به‌جای خطوط اصلی استفاده نشود.
analyses.remaining_risks: اجرای تست مرورگر و تأیید روی DXF واقعی کاربر هنوز انجام نشده؛ تشخیص معنایی اشتباه موضوع جداگانه است.

analyses.decision: Correct root-cause boolean assignment, guard legacy invalid kind without guessing original equipment type; preserve saved drawing data and avoid destructive reset.
analyses.remaining_risks: Existing documents may contain boolean kind values from prior faulty saves; original type cannot always be inferred safely. Browser runtime and saved-data restoration must be checked by user; full V320 source audit pending.

analyses.decision: Use one writer for the page lifetime rather than non-atomic localStorage leases. Fail closed in unsupported contexts. Archive legacy bytes before migration, retain recovery DB and immutable first mirror. Restore the same revision-owned display fields recorded by snapshots. Replace obsolete assertions against removed products/modal UI with active catalog and DOM integration contracts.
analyses.remaining_risks: Real two-tab/browser/device acceptance pending: Chromium binaries could not be downloaded. Old application tabs predating Web Locks must be closed during upgrade. Rendering changes deferred until real-device profiling; undo keeps one newest snapshot even if individually larger than the 32 MiB budget. Recovery bundles are archives, not roomplan imports.

analyses.decision: A revision with explicit legacy connectionModel must be migrated independently. Inherited current state applies only when revision has no marker, preserving legacy compatibility.
analyses.remaining_risks: No user runtime validation. Cross-store storage atomicity and browser recovery acceptance remain separate outstanding concerns.

analyses.decision: Treat lostpointercapture as cancellation, not a successful crop; preserve previous crop on interrupted gesture. Align PDF module cache references and existing Project Evolution identity fields in same source release.
analyses.remaining_risks: User must validate PDF crop cancellation and import on browser/device. No tests or builds run per user policy.

analyses.decision: Failed safeStorage writes shadow durable rd_last; restore prior rd_last as well as profiles before queued mirror compensation, retaining journal unless both restorations and owned mirror succeed. Block new Import/Revision while either recovery journal exists. After asynchronous history archive, recheck document identity, epoch, local snapshots and journals before mutation. Store deterministic Git-blob inventory and noncontiguous actual review ranges without claiming repository-wide review.
analyses.remaining_risks: No cross-store ACID transaction; generation and checksum sidecars cannot rank divergent valid snapshots. Crash before compensation, absent previous snapshot, malformed journals and storage failures need further review/user runtime acceptance. Preserve pre-migration archives and valid legacy local precedence. No automated tests/build/runtime executed.

analyses.decision: Keep raw legacy storage formats; reject malformed/duplicate/mismatched journal key/value/hash arrays before replay; unsupported/future records remain exportable. Local rollback is not proof of mirror compensation, so journal and autosave barrier persist for explicit review. Preserve failed-delete raw bytes in safeStorage fallback. Repair profile shadow after rejected profile save. Capture exact journal in mirror completion. Export related current values and stop stale acknowledgement. One-time lock exception does not enable future stealing.
analyses.remaining_risks: No cross-store ACID or authority between divergent valid snapshots. Crash before compensation, storage denial, absent prior snapshot and download retention remain user-review risks. Historical multiple-of-five audit evidence remains incomplete. No tests/build/compilation/browser/product execution.

تشخیص پیشنهادی توالت، پیش‌فرض ثابت سانتی‌متر و ضریب ۱، نمایش رنگی و جزئیات سراسری، منوی نمایش محصول و پیام کامیت فارسی. رادیوباتن نحوهٔ نمایش و محل نام در چهار سمت.
اصلاح تجمیعی فلش جزئیات، رنگ خطوط بدون کادر، تب‌های ورود DXF، انتخاب همه، تشخیص میز آرایش، چرخش و زیرمنوی فارسی؛ جابه‌جایی دکمه‌ها کنار بازگشت.
گزینهٔ میلی‌متر را در فهرست واحد ورود DXF اصلاح کردم؛ نسخهٔ نمایشی، کلیدهای کش و دفتر تکامل پروژه را هماهنگ کردم.
خطای محاسبهٔ سقف خطوط در ورود DXF را اصلاح کردم تا قطعه‌خط‌های تبدیل‌شده به آبجکت، دوباره به‌عنوان دیوار شمارش نشوند؛ نسخه و کش را هماهنگ کردم.
حذف ناایمن دیوارهای هم‌پوشان با نقاط فلش جزئیات را متوقف کردم تا مسیری از میان دیوار عبور نکند؛ نسخهٔ نمایشی، کش و تکامل پروژه را هماهنگ کردم.
اشکال افزودن پسوند به نام لایه‌های اصلی DXF که با RD_ شروع می‌شوند را برطرف کردم؛ لایه‌های داخلی همچنان پسوند نوع آبجکت را دریافت می‌کنند و نسخه را هماهنگ کردم.
ورود نادرست بیضی‌های خارج از صفحه XY را متوقف کردم و هشدار مناسب، نسخه و دفتر تکامل را هماهنگ کردم.
ورود بی‌هشدار خطوط سه‌بعدی DXF را متوقف کردم و گزارش هشدار، نسخه و دفتر تکامل پروژه را هماهنگ کردم.
تبدیل خاموش پلی‌لاین‌های دارای ارتفاع DXF را متوقف کردم و هشدار و نسخه را هماهنگ کردم.
ورود بی‌هشدار کمان، دایره و بیضی دارای مؤلفه ارتفاع را متوقف کردم و هشدار و نسخه را هماهنگ کردم.
ورود بی‌هشدار بلوک‌های دارای ارتفاع در DXF را متوقف کردم و هشدار و نسخه را هماهنگ کردم.
جهت کمان بیضی‌های دارای نرمال منفی DXF را اصلاح کردم و بردار نرمال نامعتبر را با هشدار کنار گذاشتم.
خطای نحوی فراخوانی ساخت لایه کابل DXF را اصلاح کردم تا اسکریپت اصلی ویور اجرا شود؛ نسخه و کش را هماهنگ کردم.
تب‌های ورود DXF را واضح کردم، واحد پیش‌فرض را سانتی‌متر با ضریب یک قرار دادم و گزینه حفظ مختصات را توضیح دادم.
تشخیص آبجکت‌های DXF را هنگام ورود به تب و تغییر واحد، لایه و برش خودکار کردم و تست‌های رگرسیون مرتبط افزودم.
جانمایی جزئیات، ترتیب نمایش تجهیزات، چرخش ۱۸۰ درجه و گروه‌بندی خصوصیات را اصلاح کردم.
ترتیب تصاویر پس‌زمینه را پس از افزودن Z-index حفظ کردم و تشخیص پیش‌فرض دربل را تکمیل کردم.
انتظار نامحدود حذف مسدودشده پایگاه داده بازیابی را برطرف کردم تا صف ذخیره آینه تعیین‌تکلیف شود.
از بازنویسی داده نامعتبر جلوگیری کردم و بازیابی کنترل‌شده مرورگر را اضافه کردم.
رفع خطای اعتبارسنجی جزئیات محصولات قدیمی و بازگشایی امن نقشه ذخیره‌شده.
کادرهای تشخیص DXF را از نمایش پیش‌فرض حذف و مشاهده اختیاری آن‌ها را اضافه کردم.
شکل و اندازه اصلی تخت و تجهیزات را هنگام ورود DXF حفظ کردم.
خرابی سراسری درج آبجکت ناشی از تبدیل kind به بولی و خطای kind.slice را اصلاح کردم.
تکرار غیرضروری هزاران خط در پیش‌نمایش DXF هنگام کمتر بودن خطوط از سقف نمونه‌برداری را برطرف کردم و نسخه‌ها را هماهنگ کردم.
ماندن خطای بارگذاری ماژول PDF در حافظه و جلوگیری از تلاش مجدد برای ورود فایل را اصلاح کردم.
باقی‌ماندن عضویت گروه پس از حذف، برش یا حذف لایه و قفل‌شدن دسترسی به خصوصیات عضو تنها را برطرف کردم.
موارد ممیزی حفاظت داده و Revision را اصلاح کردم؛ آزمون‌های قرارداد فعلی و محدودیت حافظه Undo را افزودم.
مغایرت شماره نسخه بسته و فایل قفل وابستگی‌ها با نسخه برنامه را اصلاح کردم و نمایش نسخه، کلیدهای کش و سند تکامل پروژه را هماهنگ کردم.
بازماندن برش ناتمام DXF پس از لغو اشاره‌گر یا از دست رفتن غیرمنتظره کنترل آن را اصلاح کردم و نسخه برنامه را هماهنگ کردم.
اصلاح تصمیم مهاجرت Revision دارای نشانگر نسخه قدیمی: نسخه صریح snapshot دیگر با وضعیت نسخه جاری سند والد نادیده گرفته نمی‌شود؛ snapshots فاقد نشانگر همچنان وضعیت والد را به ارث می‌برند.
لغو یا ازدست‌رفتن pointer capture در برش PDF دیگر تغییر نیمه‌تمام را ثبت نمی‌کند؛ بازگردانی کادر قبلی و هماهنگ‌سازی کش ماژول PDF و شناسه‌های نسخه انجام شد.
ترمیم وضعیت rd_last پس از شکست ذخیره Revision، جلوگیری از بازنویسی Journal معلق و توقف ادامه ذخیره بر پایه آرشیو منقضی؛ ثبت checkpoint و فهرست پایدار رگرسیون و پروتکل نویسنده انحصاری.
اعتبارسنجی کامل Journal و حفظ رکوردهای ناقص؛ حفاظت اطلاعات بازیابی در شکست پاک‌سازی و rollback، توقف autosave و مهاجرت تا تعیین‌تکلیف بازیابی؛ تکمیل بسته خروجی و تطبیق مالک Journal در callback آینه.
